newsitem.title: JAPAN: SIMEX Brent crude tad firmer in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent crude tad firmer in quiet market.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures were quoted a fraction higher in quiet afternoon trade, suffering a dearth of participants due to the Eid-al Adha public holiday in Singapore, traders said on Friday.
As of 0620 GMT, June Brent was not traded but quoted at $17.69/17.80 per barrel, compared with the Thursday London settlement of $17.69.
NYMEX crude futures on the ACCESS after-hours system were also slightly firmer.
Crude oil for May delivery stood at $19.47/19.49, after closing two cents higher on Thursday at $19.42.
